keyboardDoc.intro: Every keyboard shortcut in rooster. Press ? in the app to see them at any time; this page is generated from the same list.

notation.mod: ⌘ on a Mac is Ctrl on Windows and Linux, and ⌥ is Alt.
notation.tab: ⇥ (Tab) before a key is a Tab chord: hold Tab and press the key. Chords also work while you edit a title.
notation.sequence: Two keys in a row, such as G then M, are pressed one after the other, within a second.
